card.name: Dosing and drug absorption or clearance terms
card.fires_on: The first part of "dosing" ("dos") after words like once-daily or less frequent, and pharmacokinetic nouns such as absorption and clearance after "continued" or "increases the", mostly in theophylline and phenytoin label text.

modes.description: The nouns absorption or clearance describing how a drug moves through the body, especially theophylline.
